execute.basis: no memory client is on this queue's path; its unit writes in command order

load.basis: the dispatch releases a younger command at the older one's issue, and the memory client tracks several transactions whose responses may return in any order

store.basis: no memory client is on this queue's path; its unit writes in command order

semantics.overlap_completion: younger waits for older completion when the local row accesses overlap
semantics.disjoint_completion: younger waits for older completion even when local row accesses do not overlap; no address tracking assumption needed
semantics.tracked_null: no address-specific tracking proof is claimed; accepted here only when both overlap and disjoint are completion
semantics.CONFIG_ST: CONFIG funct0 code2 enters store queue; issue order captures uniform configuration; store release completion; no change of CONFIG_ST word inside region
semantics.retained_source: every original store has completed original K prefix; removing completions preserves all data effects and their issue order
semantics.ownership: RHS loads precede all readers; no later load or accumulator writer occurs until original closing store END drain; original disjoint-ACC interval proof retained
